info.header: Welcome to the kana (hiragana and katakana) dojo!
info.description: This is the place where you can learn and practice the two core syllabaries of Japanese - Hiragana and Katakana.
info.instructions: To begin, select at least 1 set of characters, select or change the training mode, then hit Go! below and start training now!
